data.notes: Volvo newsroom VDA press data could not be reached via search; most values come from ADAC Autokatalog (manufacturer data) as fallback - flagged in sources. Search budget (20) fully used. All XC90/EX90 generations are 7-seaters (EX90 also 6-seat); trunkL is the 3rd-row-folded value, 7-seat values in notes.

corrections.evidence: Volvo media page XC90 Gen 1 (2002): 'wheelbase 286 cm, length 480 cm, width 190 cm, height 179 cm'. carsales.com.au 2003 XC90 D5: length 4798, height 1784, wheelbase 2857 mm. 1743 mm (Parkers/AutoScout24) is likely without roof rails; manufacturer figure ~1784 mm.

AUTO BILD gen-1 overview gives trunk range 249-1837 l for the whole first generation (2002-2014); Volvo AT press release (volvocars.com/at/media/press-releases/8E9924F398307BCF) states max load volume 1837 l; gebrauchtwagenberater.de 613-1837 l. Same body as facelift (1837 l).
ADAC model overview lists Volvo XC90 2.5T with 154 kW / 210 PS; ultimatespecs also 210 PS / 154 kW.
Ultimatespecs: XC90 V8 (MY2005) 315 PS (232 kW), 4414 ccm; encycarpedia.com/de 05-xc90-v8-awd consistent (440 Nm). US rating 311 hp is SAE.

Ultimatespecs: D5 163 PS / 120 kW, 2401 ccm; largus.fr lists 'D5 163ch' (2004), marketed until 06/2005. Note: from ~2005/06 a 185 PS D5 (autoplenum '2.4 D5 DPF 185 PS (2002-2006)') replaced it - consider splitting.
Volvo XC90 spec page (B5 AWD Mild hybrid): 'Vehicle length 4 953 mm ... Wheel base 2 984 mm'; autotijd.be B5/B6 AWD (2024-) also 4953 mm / 2984 mm, width 1923 mm w/o mirrors.

Volvo official ES90 spec pages (intl, mt, sg, my): luggage 424 l with 2nd row up (904 l seats folded, window-high); max-capacity figures 446 l / 1427 l; frunk 27 l. carwow.de and test reports also 424 l. ADAC's 442 l matches only the Indonesian Volvo page. Task rule: prefer manufacturer figure. Applies to all three variants.

Volvo official ES90 spec page gives maximum load capacity 1427 l with rear seats folded; echo24.de test: '424 Liter ... mit umgelegter Rückbank 1.427 Liter'. ADAC 1445 l differs. Applies to Single Motor ER and Twin Motor variants (and fills Performance null).
Volvo spec (Single Motor Extended Range): 424 l with 2nd row up.

verification.notes: Confirmed: XC90 I length 4798 (Volvo 480 cm), width 1898, wheelbase 2857, yearFrom 2002 (production from Aug 2002, Volvo media) and yearTo 2014 (last car 11 Jul 2014), facelift ADAC entries from 11/06 (yearFrom 2007 ok), facelift 4807/1898/1784/2857 and 1837 l. XC90 I 5-seat trunk: secondary sources give 613 l (gebrauchtwagenberater, medidasdecoches) or 615 l (Parkers) with 249 l 7-seat; ADAC 5-seat 3.2 gives 483 l; no Volvo VDA figure found -> trunkL left null (conflicting). XC90 II: length 4950, wheelbase 2984, 302/680/1856 and PHEV 262/640/1816 consistent with carwow; width 1931 mm NOT confirmed (sources give 1923 w/o mirrors for 2019+/2024 models, 2008 mm with folded mirrors) - unresolved, no correction. Facelift 2024: 4953/1923/1771 confirmed (height 1767-1776 elsewhere). EX90: 5037/1964/1744/2985 confirmed; trunk conflicting: ADAC 324/697/2135 vs firmenauto 324/669/1955 vs UK press 310/655/1915 - no Volvo DE figure retrieved, no correction. ES90 dimensions 5000/1942/1547/3102 confirmed. 18 of 20 searches used.
